name: cerebro
description: Permanent verbatim archive + search over all Claude Code sessions

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --compile --outfile dist/cerebro --define __CEREBRO_VERSION__="\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --define __CEREBRO_COMMIT__="\"$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\"" --define __CEREBRO_BUILT_AT__="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
scripts.deploy: bun run build && DEST="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/cerebro" && mkdir -p "$DEST" && cp dist/cerebro "$DEST/cerebro" && cp hooks/summarize-on-clear.sh "$DEST/summarize-on-clear.sh" && cp hooks/digest-stale-batch.sh "$DEST/digest-stale-batch.sh" && chmod +x "$DEST/summarize-on-clear.sh" "$DEST/digest-stale-batch.sh"
